verdict.rationale: bizfile California is documented as a public portal to search business records. Plain copies of filed entity documents can be printed online, and apostille issuance can be verified publicly. Together these let a founder see that a filing or apostille has been recorded, but nothing documents a public tracker for a pending filing, application or case. The vote-by-mail ballot tracker is for voters, not business filings, and is not credited. Missing for 10: a documented public status lookup for submitted business filings or applications (pending, in review, rejected), case/application-number tracking, status notifications for business filings, and hands-on corroboration that the portal can be reached and used.

support.subject: As a founder, I can look up the status of my filing, application, or case from the service's public pages

citations.quote: Welcome to bizfile California, the Secretary of State’s online portal to help businesses file, search, and order business records.
Customers can print plain copies of business entity documents online at bizfileOnline.sos.ca.gov including formation/registration, amendments, terminations and statements of information.
